prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 服务器安全基线核查记录 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "受检服务器唯一编号" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 120px
  col 2: header "系统账户口令强度" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 3: header "外部网络访问开放" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 4: header "日志留存天数达标" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 107px
  col 5: header "漏洞补丁更新状态" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 6: header "高危端口关闭数量" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 7: header "近三十天告警次数" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 8: header "应急联系人确认情况" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 120px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 528px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 527px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A server security baseline audit record: six servers checked against multiple compliance items, intended for verification, comparison, and sign-off.","reading":"Readers identify a server by the first column, then scan across its status and numeric checks; binary results are compared vertically, while days and counts are compared as quantities.","groups":["Column 1 is the row identifier and should stand apart from the check columns.","Columns 2, 3, 5, and 8 are binary compliance/confirmation statuses (是/否) and can share narrow widths.","Columns 4, 6, and 7 are quantitative measures (days, port count, alert count) and benefit from extra width for numeric alignment."],"keep_intact":["Server identifiers 01–06","Numeric values such as 180, 90, 365, 30, port counts, and alert counts","是/否 values","Two-character Chinese header terms where possible, avoiding single-character orphans"],"may_wrap":["Long Chinese headers, especially 系统账户口令强度, 外部网络访问开放, 漏洞补丁更新状态, and 应急联系人确认情况","The nine-character identifier and emergency-contact headers may wrap to two or three lines","Data cells should remain on one line"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 66, 65] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [70, 63, 63, 67, 63, 67, 67, 67] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [64, 62, 62, 75, 62, 63, 75, 64] · table 528×273px · row heights [73, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}
